verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that reusing a `thread_id` continues the same session, and that the VM keeps a persistent file workspace. Neither is documented memory that carries relevant context from previous chats into new conversations. Same-thread continuation is a different capability, and a file workspace is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations
